text: A versioned, compact metadata format encoded in the marker (POI kind, name/id, side length in mm, optional parameters), documented, with a decoder that rejects unknown versions.

A config-file driven generator that writes a print-ready PDF (exact physical size, quiet zone, label) and two-colour STL (separate base and module bodies, configurable thickness/relief, Bambu AMS friendly, 3MF with both parts); tests check sizes, module grid and round-trip decode of the rendered output.
The generator also produces the calibration pattern (PDF and two-colour STL) the head RGB-D fusion epic needs, with that epic's exact square and marker sizes, fitting a 256x256 mm bed.
READMEs and tests for the codec and the generator.
Any black/white square-ish marker is fine; decision: QR Model 2.
Metadata in the marker allows automatic POI conversion and states its size (always square).
Outputs PDF and two-colour STL for a Bambu Lab printer with AMS: base body plus raised black modules as separate objects; 3MF with both parts.
The generator also produces the RGB-D calibration pattern (ChArUco).
